user_saw: Nothing visible; a Gateway with many sessions kept roughly 14 MB of completed restart-recovery data in memory after startup.
summary: Clears preparation.recoverInputs after restart input recovery settles so published admission callbacks no longer retain the parsed session rows, and reuses assertionSucceeds for a line-cap.
reasoning: This is a bounded, one-time memory retention reduction (13-14 MB on a 35 GiB synthetic fixture) with no reported failure; the PR itself says it does not explain long-running growth and claims no other behavior change. The retained closure dates to restart input recovery (9bf3231d253, #187822) and was never lighter, so under the rubric this is a resource optimization rather than a defect; the blamed f787a896894 lines are only the unrelated assertion-helper refactor.
